name: MiSide Menu
description: Geometry Dash's screens in the style of MiSide's interface, with an animated Mita

issues.info: Report bugs on the GitHub repository

vanilla-menu.name: Vanilla menu
vanilla-menu.description: The main menu exactly as it is without the mod. Applies the next time the main menu opens

parallax-strength.name: Parallax strength
parallax-strength.description: How far the background layers follow the mouse. 0 keeps them still

menu-language.name: Menu language
menu-language.description: The language of the menu items: RU (Russian) or EN (English)

confirm-level-exit.name: Confirm leaving a level
confirm-level-exit.description: The pause menu asks "Quit the level?" in the menu's style before leaving, even with GD's own exit confirmation off. Off: GD decides, as without the mod (its popup is then shown in this style)

show-intro.name: Studio intro
show-intro.description: The AIHASTO intro before the loading screen, at the game's start. A click or a key skips it

show-title.name: Logo
show-title.description: The logo and "Main menu" above the menu items
